verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item shows Meilisearch publishing per-unit pricing (rate per search, per record, or per node); the pricing page citations only list feature tiers (docs-15, docs-30), not consumption-based rates. Community feedback actually underscores the opposite experience — surprise jump to a flat $1200/month tier and RAM/cost unpredictability under load — reinforcing that no transparent per-unit cost model is documented.
